stemMd: Which description would correctly represent all three temperature series on one temperature-versus-time graph?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Three rising lines with Q steepest and P least steep.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Three lines with different temperatures at time0.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Three straight rising lines from the same intercept, with P steepest and Q least steep

options.label: D
options.textMd: Three horizontal lines, because heater power is constant.

explanationMd: Each series has constant increments in time and begins at20degrees. Rates are P0.2,Q0.1,R about0.133degrees C/s, ordering the slopes P,R,Q.

distractorRationale.d: Constant heating power gives temperature rises here, not constant temperature.
distractorRationale.a: This reverses the observed heating rates.
